basis.place: chosen by geography: it sits where the tale needs it, or the real feature matches
basis.likeness: chosen by form or character: it looks or behaves like the thing in the tale
basis.name: the real name already echoes the tale
basis.new: no counterpart in the tales; our own invention, always marked
